sections.what_happened: VERIFIED FACT (turnout): CEC turnout reached 44.9% by 2:00pm Israel time, up from 38.9% at the same hour in 2022; Jerusalem Post headline: 'Over three million vote as Israel sees highest election turnout since 1973'. FRAMING DISCREPANCY, NOT HIDDEN: i24NEWS and the Jerusalem Post say 'highest since 1973' for the 2pm figure, while israelrealtime says 'highest since at least 1969' -- ship the 44.9% figure with 'highest in decades', never a single 'since' year for the 2pm mark. (The noon 31.5% figure's 1973-vs-1977 discrepancy from 1600-02 stands separately.) CORROBORATION UPGRADE (was a single-undeclared-outlet monitor note at 1600-02): the knife arrest near opposition leader Yair Golan in Tel Aviv is now carried by TRT World live citing Yedioth Ahronoth and a Democrats party statement (man approached Golan's voter-mobilisation tour at Railway Park, intercepted by security guards). Yedioth/TRT carry NO declared tier in the registry, so they are reported with attribution and do NOT count toward corroboration. VERIFIED FACT (markets): Reuters reports the shekel jumped nearly 1% to 3.05 per dollar, a 3-week high (from 3.12 on Monday), with analysts linking high turnout to a possible strong opposition showing; JPMorgan predicted the shekel could swing up to 3% either way on the result. COUNTERPOINT: high turnout decides nothing by itself -- final TV polls (via Times of Israel) put Netanyahu's allies at ~50 seats and the Eisenkot-led opposition at 52-56, both short of 61; polls close 22:00 Israel time (00:00 Oct 28), exit polls then, ~650,000 special ballots take 24-36 hours, official results due Nov 4.
sections.what_verified: CEC 2pm figure via i24NEWS (undeclared, attribution only) + israelrealtime (undeclared, attribution only) + Jerusalem Post scale/framing; shekel via Reuters wire; Golan incident via Yedioth/TRT attribution only.
sections.what_disputed: CEC: no indications of systematic ballot tampering (1700-02, stands); neither bloc is projected to reach 61 seats, so turnout alone does not decide the government.
sections.why_matters: 44.9% by 2pm and the shekel's jump: record turnout, fraud claims vs the CEC rebuttal -- is this the vote that ends the Netanyahu era, or the setup for a stolen-election fight?
